reference_prolog:
/* ---------- Statutory rule we need ---------- */
applies_7703b1(Person,Year) :-
    % married at end of the year
    married(Person,Year),
    % filed a separate return (7703(b) requires a separate return)
    file_return(Person,Year,separate),
    % maintained the household for a qualifying child > 1/2 of the year
    maintains_home_more_half(Person,Child,Year),
    deduction_for(Person,Child,Year),   % sec. 151 deduction for the child
    % furnished > 1/2 of the cost of maintaining the household
    furnishes_over_half_cost(Person,Year),
    % spouse not a member of the household during the last 6 months
    spouse_not_member_last6(Person,Year).

/* ---------- Facts from the case ---------- */
married(alice,2018).

/* Alice and Bob filed a JOINT return for 2018 */
file_return(alice,2018,joint).

/* Charlie lived with Alice for all of 2018, and Alice is entitled to the
   dependency deduction for him. */
maintains_home_more_half(alice,charlie,2018).
deduction_for(alice,charlie,2018).

/* Alice furnished over half of the cost of the household. */
furnishes_over_half_cost(alice,2018).

/* No fact is provided that Bob was absent from the household for the
   last 6 months, so we do NOT assert spouse_not_member_last6(alice,2018). */


/* ---------- Verification goal ---------- */
:- (  applies_7703b1(alice,2018)
   -> format('Result: Entailment~n')
   ;  format('Result: Contradiction~n')
   ).
:- halt.

expected.question: Section 7703(b)(1) applies to Alice for the year 2018.
